title: Moses Shows Signs, and Pharaoh Calls the Magicians

paragraphs.text: Pharaoh turned to the people around him and said, "Do you not hear this?" Moses continued, "He is your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers." Pharaoh said, "Your messenger is mad!" Moses replied, "He is Lord of the east and the west and all between them, if you would only think." Pharaoh became angry. He threatened that if Moses took any god other than Pharaoh, he would put him in prison. Moses asked, "Even if I bring you a clear proof?" Pharaoh told him to bring it, if he was telling the truth.

Moses threw his staff, and at once it became a real serpent. Then he drew out his hand, and it was shining white for all who watched. Pharaoh told his chiefs that Moses was a skilled magician. He claimed Moses wanted to drive them out of their land with his magic. He asked them for advice. They told him to delay the matter of Moses and his brother. They said he should send men to the cities to gather every skilled magician.

So the magicians were brought together on a fixed, well-known day. The people were asked to gather too, so they could follow the magicians if they won. When the magicians came, they asked Pharaoh if they would get a reward if they were the winners.

hardWords.m: a place where people are locked up
a person who does magic tricks
